compatibility.additive_change: new minor release (1.x.0) with tests and fixtures; consumers may ignore new optional fields
compatibility.breaking_change: new major release with adapters and a migration for every pinned consumer; both repositories adopt in the same week or record why not
compatibility.schema_version_const: episode and transition records carry schema_version 1.0.0; a breaking change bumps it

notes: Schemas are unchanged from the 2026-10-30 reference release.
